The [Policy Lab Guide](https://iat-dml.github.io/policy-codesign-methods/) is a work-in-progress project to guide researchers and practictioners in the development of **Policy Labs for Agri-environmental Measures** within the setting of Living Labs. The guide is designed to be a practical resource for those looking to co-design, test and evaluate policy interventions in collaboration with stakeholders, providing recommended methods for each step of the process.

It offers two ways in: a **concept diagram** that lays out the Policy Lab phases in a visual format, and a searchable **methods library** where every method can be filtered by phase, actor, effort, and skill level.

The guide is being developed collaboratively with colleagues at ZALF: [Bettina Matzdorf](https://www.zalf.de/de/ueber_uns/mitarbeiter/Seiten/matzdorf_b.aspx), Joana Iwaniw, [Ben Black](https://blenback.github.io/), and [Sebastian Rogga](https://www.zalf.de/de/ueber_uns/mitarbeiter/Seiten/Rogga_S.aspx). But in the near future we hope to open the guide up for contributions from the wider community of researchers and practitioners working in the field of policy co-design and Living Labs especially within the IAT. [Please get in touch if you would like to contribute or provide feedback on the guide](mailto:iat-dml@zalf.de)
